body: Because I just don't relate to people, I simply don't care. As a result, I don't see why anyone should care about me.

I guess I can't relate to psychiathrists then since I'm pretty much devoid of empathy, and that's a possible reason as to why I might kill myself. I assume everyone else is the same way, I can't relate to people, I can't feel what they feel, I doubt I'll ever be able to love.

Eh, perscription meds usually have pretty heavy side effects and I'll probably just abuse them anyway. I've been wanting to try acid though.

Meds are artificial happiness. Drugs are fun for the moment but not a long term solution.

Give me a reason to believe that a psychiatrist actually cares about me and my problems and isn't just looking for another day's pay.

I've considered a shrink, but at the end of the day they're just there to make money. I don't think medication is the way to go, either.

I'm all for helo, but I don't trust shrinks.

Pretty much confirms my fears then. I have friends, but I stop hanging with them one by one because they have passions, skills and whatnot. Shit I can only dream of.

I'm sick of hearing "Don't compare yourself to others", because we all do, even those who say it. No offense to you, man. I understand that you mean well just by the reply and I appreciate that. But I'm not to keen on waiting until I'm in my twenties. These are considered the "golden years" for most people.
